description: This is a white, multi-tiered chandelier designed to be hung from the ceiling. It features a central chain connecting to a circular frame, from which six arms extend downwards and outwards. Each arm supports a cylindrical lampshade with a decorative, open-weave pattern. The central frame also has intricate detailing, suggesting an ornate and classic design. The overall aesthetic is delicate and elegant, with a focus on intricate craftsmanship.
